title: Error response of artws-sec/v1
description: The WordPress REST API error shape plus schema_version, as artws-security-hub writes it. The client decides by the HTTP status, and uses code only where one status has several meanings. WordPress itself may answer some requests (an unknown route, a body that is not JSON) in its own shape without schema_version, so the client handles any 4xx or 5xx by its status.

code.description: One of the codes listed in the README (artws_sec_rate_limited, ...).

message.description: English plain text for logs and support, not for the store owner: the client shows its own text for the status.

status.description: The HTTP status of the response.

retry_at.description: 429 only: the earliest time the site may run the check again (the Retry-After header carries the same time in seconds).
